Headline: CFD Gold Arena, Round 7: Share 80,000 USDT Across Two Leaderboards, with Up to 13,000 USDT in XAUT p...
Prize pool: 80K USDT
Start: 2026-11-16T09:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-07T09:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 13000 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 10000 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
CFD Gold Arena is now live, with leaderboards for trading volume and profit. Sign up and trade CFDs to compete on both leaderboards for total rewards of up to 13,000 USDT in XAUT per user. Meet the daily trading requirement to receive a 20 USDx Trading Fee Rebate Voucher, even without a leaderboard ranking.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 16, 2026, 09:00 – December 7, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: CFD Trading Volume Leaderboard, Earn Up to 10,000 USDT in XAUT
During the event, sign up and reach a cumulative CFD trading volume of at least 100,000 USDx after registration to qualify for the CFD Trading Volume Leaderboard. Users are ranked by cumulative CFD trading volume after registration, from highest to lowest. The top 200 users who meet the applicable reward thresholds will receive rewards from a pool of XAUT spot tokens worth 65,000 USDT, with up to 10,000 USDT in XAUT per user.
Note: If users have the same cumulative CFD trading volume, those who reached the 100,000 USDx trading volume threshold first will rank higher. Places left vacant because users do not meet the reward thresholds will not be reassigned. Users ranked 1–3 must reach a cumulative CFD trading volume of 1,000,000,000 USDx to claim their rewards.
Rank | Reward per User (Paid in XAUT)
1st Place | 10,000 USDT
2nd Place | 5,000 USDT
3rd Place | 3,000 USDT
4th–10th Place | 2,000 USDT
11th–50th Place | 550 USDT
51st–100th Place | 200 USDT
101st–200th Place | 10 USDT
## Event 2: CFD Profit Leaderboard, Earn Up to 3,000 USDT
During the event, sign up and reach a cumulative CFD trading volume of at least 100,000 USDx and cumulative net profit of at least 10,000 USDx after registration to qualify for the CFD Profit Leaderboard. Users are ranked by cumulative net profit after registration, from highest to lowest. The top 30 users who meet the applicable reward thresholds will receive rewards from a pool of XAUT spot tokens worth 15,000 USDT, with up to 3,000 USDT in XAUT per user, until the pool is exhausted.
Note: If users have the same cumulative realized net profit, those who reached the 100,000 USDx trading volume threshold first will rank higher. Places left vacant because users do not meet the reward thresholds will not be reassigned.
Rank | Reward per User (Paid in XAUT) | Minimum Cumulative Realized Net Profit
1st Place | 3,000 USDT | ≥ 50,000 USDx
2nd–3rd Place | 1,500 USDT | ≥ 35,000 USDx
4th–10th Place | 1,000 USDT | ≥ 30,000 USDx
11th–30th Place | 100 USDT | ≥ 10,000 USDx
## Special Bonus: Trading Cashback — Earn 20 USDx for Trading Daily
During the event, after registering, users who reach a cumulative CFD trading volume of at least 100,000 USDx on a check-in day will receive a 20 USDx CFD Trading Fee Rebate Voucher for that day. Each user can receive one reward per check-in day. A total of 10,000 vouchers are available. Rewards are credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Dual Leaderboard Reward Details
Results for Event 1 and Event 2 are calculated separately. Each user can receive one ranking reward from each leaderboard. Rewards from both leaderboards can be combined for a total of up to 13,000 USDT in XAUT per user. The Special Bonus can be earned in addition to leaderboard rewards and does not count toward the leaderboard prize pools or the maximum leaderboard reward per user.
## Important Notes
All participants must complete identity verification before registering, then select [Join Now] to sign up. Registration and participation are currently unavailable in some regions due to local policies and service restrictions.
Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. Only data recorded after registration counts toward this event.
Rewards from [Event 1], [Event 2], and [Special Bonus] can be combined.
Net profit for [Event 2] includes only CFD positions opened and closed during the event period after registration. Positions still open when the event ends do not count toward the profit leaderboard. Net profit is calculated from the actual settled PnL of eligible positions, after deducting trading fees and other applicable costs. The final calculation results will apply.
Rewards for [Event 1] and [Event 2] are paid in XAUT spot tokens, not physical gold. The button text will not change after task completion. Rewards will be credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends. [Special Bonus] rewards are issued as CFD Trading Fee Rebate Vouchers with a 20% rebate rate and are credited automatically after the corresponding tasks are completed. If a reward is not credited, all available rewards have been claimed or the user does not meet the task eligibility requirements.
[Special Bonus] Each trading check-in day runs from 00:00:00 (UTC) to 23:59:59 (UTC) on the same day. Reaching the trading volume threshold multiple times in the same period still counts as only one valid check-in day. Check-in days do not need to be consecutive. Trading check-ins cannot be completed, and rewards cannot be earned, while CFD markets are closed on weekends.
Gate TradFi services may be restricted in certain jurisdictions, and users in some regions may be temporarily unable to use this feature. Trading traditional financial instruments involves market volatility, leverage risk, and liquidity risk. Before enabling TradFi trading, carefully read the Contract for Difference (CFD) Service Agreement, the Risk Disclosure Statement, and the terms for each asset.
Users who participate in other Gate events of the same type during the same period can receive rewards from only one event.
Bulk account registration, malicious volume manipulation, self-trading, collusive wash trading, and other forms of cheating are strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts belonging to the same identity-verified user will be treated as one account. Subaccounts are not eligible to participate in this event.
Market makers, companies, and institutions are not eligible to participate in this event.
If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version prevails.
Gate reserves the right to make the final interpretation of this event.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot access all or part of the services, including participation in this event, games, or contests. For details about restricted regions, please read the User Agreement.

Join Now

During the event, new futures users who complete their first ZEC/USDT futures trade with a trading volume of ≥ 1,000 USDT will receive a 3 USDT reward. The total prize pool is 10,000 USDT, available on a first-come, first-served basis.

During the event, users who trade ZEC/USDT futures and reach a cumulative valid trading volume of 10,000 USDT can enter the trading volume leaderboard.

Rank | Rewards
1st Place | 8,000 USDT
Rank 2–5 | Split 10,000 USDT evenly
Rank 6–20 | Split 5,000 USDT evenly
Rank 21–100 | Split 5,000 USDT by share of trading volume, up to 150 USDT per person
All Other Users on the Leaderboard | Split 12,000 USDT by share of trading volume, up to 100 USDT per person

During the event, users at VIP 5 and above who register and complete ZEC/USDT futures trading, reaching the corresponding cumulative valid trading volume threshold, can claim additional USDT rewards. Rewards are distributed based on the highest tier reached during the event period. Rewards from different tiers cannot be stacked. Cumulative Valid Trading Volume | Individual Reward
≥ 100,000 USDT | 10 USDT
≥ 300,000 USDT | 20 USDT

Participants must click the [Join Now] button on the event page to register and complete Identity Verification to receive rewards.
In [Event 1], "new users" refers to users who have never traded futures since signing up.
Users must trade the ZEC/USDT perpetual futures pair to qualify for rewards. Trading Volume = Buy Amount + Sell Amount. API trades do not count toward the event trading volume.
Rewards will be distributed in USDT. All rewards will be credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends. Individual rewards of less than 1 USDT do not meet the minimum distribution threshold and will not be issued.
If a user participates in multiple similar Gate events at the same time, they will only receive the reward from one event.
Batch registration of dummy accounts, malicious volume inflation, wash trading, matched orders, and other cheating behaviors are strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts under the same verified user will be treated as one account. Subaccounts are not eligible to participate in the event.
Market makers, enterprises, and institutions cannot participate in this event.
If there is any discrepancy between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the right to final interpretation of this event.

Headline: Gate Stocks Player One: Trade to Win GTA6 and TTWO Shares
Start: 2026-11-16T09:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-26T09:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 5 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 500 USDT (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Trade stocks and stock futures on Gate for a chance to win GTA6 game redemption codes, actual shares in Take-Two (TTWO), the parent company of Rockstar Games, Futures Position Vouchers, Stock Trial Funds, and other rewards.
During the campaign, first-time users of Gate's direct U.S. stock trading service can receive TTWO shares. Complete trading tasks and trade in both markets to earn additional prize draw entries. The prizes include 100 genuine GTA6 game redemption codes.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 16, 2026, 09:00 (UTC) – November 26, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Log in to Gate, visit the campaign page, and click [Join Now] to register. During the campaign, trade designated U.S. stocks through Gate's direct stock trading service or designated stock USDT-margined perpetual futures. Eligible instruments are listed on the campaign page. Only valid trades made after successful registration will count.
## Activity 1: First Trade Rewards, Receive Actual TTWO Shares
During the campaign, users trading U.S. stocks on Gate for the first time can receive 5 USDT equivalent in actual TTWO shares by registering and making cumulative purchases of 100 USDT equivalent or more in any stocks.
Limited to the first 100 eligible users, with one reward per user. Eligibility is determined by the time each user completes all task requirements.
First-time participation is determined by the user's historical trades in Gate's direct U.S. stock trading service. Users who have traded stock futures but have not previously traded U.S. stocks on Gate are also eligible for this activity.
## Activity 2: Trade to Unlock Prize Draw Entries and Win GTA6
After successful registration, complete the cumulative valid trading volume tasks below to earn prize draw entries. Stock trading and stock futures trading are two independent task tracks, with trading volume and rewards calculated separately.
Task Track | Cumulative Valid Trading Volume | Additional Entries at This Tier
U.S. stock trading | ≥ 500 USDT equivalent | 1
U.S. stock trading | ≥ 10,000 USDT equivalent | 1
U.S. stock trading | ≥ 200,000 USDT equivalent | 2
Stock futures trading | ≥ 20,000 USDT | 1
Stock futures trading | ≥ 200,000 USDT | 1
Stock futures trading | ≥ 2,000,000 USDT | 2
Additional entries from different tiers are cumulative. Each tier can be completed once during the entire campaign. Users can earn up to 4 entries per task track and up to 8 entries across both tracks. The entire campaign is one cumulative task period: trading volume does not reset daily and is not combined across products.
## Prize Draw Rewards
Prize | Reward per Winner
Genuine GTA6 Standard Edition game redemption code | 1 redemption code
Actual TTWO shares | 50 USDT equivalent
Actual TTWO shares | 10 USDT equivalent
Stock Trial Funds | 100 USDT value
Stock Trial Funds | 10 USDT value
Stock Trial Funds | 5 USDT value
Futures Position Voucher | 100 USDT value
Futures Position Voucher | 50 USDT value
Futures Position Voucher | 10 USDT value
## Prize Draw Rules
- Each prize draw entry automatically generates one valid entry number. The draw will take place after the campaign ends and data verification is completed. Users do not need to use their entries manually.
- Prizes will be drawn in the order shown in the table above. In each round, winning numbers are selected randomly from the remaining valid entry numbers, with each number having an equal chance of being selected.
- Each user may win a maximum of one prize in the draw. Once a user wins, all of their remaining entry numbers will be excluded from subsequent draws. The first-trade stock reward in Activity 1 can be combined with a prize draw reward.
- Earning entries does not guarantee a prize. If there are insufficient eligible users, the draw will follow the order above until no eligible users remain. Any remaining prizes will not be reallocated.
- Draw results are subject to the campaign page and system records. Winners will receive a notification from Gate.
## Activity 3: Trade Stocks and Stock Futures for an Extra Entry
During the campaign, registered users who meet both requirements below will receive 1 additional prize draw entry:
Reach a cumulative valid trading volume of 1,000 USDT equivalent in TTWO stocks.
Reach a cumulative valid trading volume of 20,000 USDT in TTWO stock futures.
## Terms and Conditions
- All rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the campaign ends and verification of valid trades, user eligibility, and draw results is completed. Game code claim procedures, eligible regions, and platform versions are subject to the campaign page and winner notifications.
- Users must successfully register, complete the identity verification required by Gate, and meet the requirements for using the relevant products and claiming rewards. Each user may participate with only one account. Multiple accounts sharing the same identity verification information will be treated as one participant. Subaccounts are not independently eligible for rewards.
- Eligible stock trading in this campaign refers to direct U.S. stock trading, while eligible stock futures refer to stock USDT-margined perpetual futures. CFDs, stock tokens, non-designated markets, and simulated trades do not count. Stock futures are derivatives; holding a futures position does not constitute ownership of shares in the underlying company.
- Stock trading volume is calculated as the sum of actual buy and sell transaction values. Activity 1 is assessed separately based on cumulative purchases. Stock futures trading volume is calculated as the sum of executed buy and sell notional values, rather than the margin used. Transactions denominated in currencies other than USDT will be converted using the exchange rates applied in Gate's calculations.
- Unfilled orders, the unfilled portions of canceled orders, fund transfers, reward distributions, and IPO subscriptions and allocations themselves do not count toward trading volume. Trades in trial positions funded by the platform, as well as abnormal trades, do not count toward campaign tasks.
- TTWO stock rewards consist of actual shares credited to the user's Gate Stock Account. Reward amounts will be converted into the actual number of shares according to the stock pricing rules for the relevant distribution batch. The applicable precision and number of shares credited are subject to system records. Stock prices may fluctuate, and the stated reward value does not represent a fixed value after crediting. Users must open an eligible account and have the necessary permissions to receive the stock before claiming the reward.
- Stock Trial Funds are used to obtain trial positions in designated stocks. Trial funds and positions are managed separately from regular stock holdings. Trial funds and trial shares cannot be transferred, withdrawn, or moved to another account. Profits from selling or settlement upon expiry will be credited to the user's account according to product rules. The trial allocation itself is not granted permanently as a regular stock reward. The validity period, eligible stocks, and settlement rules are subject to the voucher details. See the Stock Trial Funds Guide for details.
- Futures Position Vouchers are used to open trial positions in designated futures markets. Their face value is not equivalent to a cash reward or a withdrawable balance. Eligible markets, account modes, leverage, validity periods, and profit settlement methods are subject to the voucher page. See the Futures Position Voucher User Guide for details.
- GTA6 game rewards are genuine redemption codes for the complete Standard Edition game. Users should confirm their gaming platform and account region as instructed in the notification, and claim and redeem their codes within the specified period. Codes do not include gaming hardware or platform subscriptions that require a separate purchase. Available versions and regions are subject to the campaign page.
- Prize draw entries are valid only for this campaign and cannot be transferred, withdrawn, or exchanged. Task and prize data may be subject to update delays. Final eligibility and rewards are based on valid data verified by Gate.
- Bulk account registration, linked-account abuse, self-trading, wash trading, fabricated trades, market manipulation, and exploiting system vulnerabilities to obtain rewards are strictly prohibited. Gate may verify account and trading data and disqualify users who violate the rules, including canceling their reward eligibility and related rewards.
- Users must comply with the Gate User Agreement, the relevant product terms, and the applicable requirements in their jurisdiction. Some regions may not have access to the relevant products or this campaign. Availability is subject to Gate's actual service coverage.
- This campaign does not constitute investment advice or a guarantee of returns. Stock and stock futures prices may fluctuate, and futures trading carries additional leverage and liquidation risks. Expressions of interest in IPO subscriptions involve risks including receiving no allocation, price fluctuations, and liquidity risks. Please understand the product rules and participate according to your own risk tolerance.
- If product arrangements, market changes, system issues, compliance requirements, or force majeure require adjustments to the campaign period, eligible instruments, rules, or rewards, Gate will announce the arrangements on the campaign page. Gate reserves the right to interpret these campaign rules to the extent permitted by applicable law.
